vega-morphcharts.js.why: Provides ViewGl, the Vega-scenegraph-to-MorphCharts adapter behind /transition. Vendored rather than loaded from a CDN so the page cannot break when upstream reorganises. Bundles morphcharts@1.x internally; that is a separate, older lineage from the WebGPU @microsoft/morphcharts-* in app/vendor/morphcharts, and the two are not interchangeable - no Vega adapter exists for the newer one.
